# Globe textures

NASA imagery, which NASA publishes without copyright (public domain). Each file was downloaded on 2026-11-20 from
the Wikimedia Commons copy of the NASA original (NASA's own record pages now redirect to science.nasa.gov) and scaled
down with macOS `sips`; nothing else was changed.

| File | Size | Image | NASA source | Copy used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blue-marble.jpg` | 4096 x 2048 | Blue Marble: Land Surface, Shallow Water, and Shaded Topography (2002), NASA Visible Earth / Earth Observatory | https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/Features/BlueMarble/ | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Whole_world_-_land_and_oceans.jpg (the NASA east and west hemispheres, combined) |
| `black-marble.jpg` | 4096 x 2048 | Earth at Night (Black Marble 2012), Suomi NPP VIIRS, NASA Earth Observatory | https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/features/NightLights | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_earth_at_night.jpg |
| `topography.png` | 2048 x 1024 | Blue Marble Topography (SRTM, grayscale height map), NASA Visible Earth | https://visibleearth.nasa.gov/images/73934 | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Srtm_ramp2.world.21600x10800.jpg |

Credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Visible Earth.
